# The RPC contract

<!-- Generated by protocol/generate_docs.py from protocol/tsugumi.fbs: do not edit. -->

The RPCs by which the UI, the Web and the Agent talk to `tsugumid`, generated from the doc comments of [protocol/tsugumi.fbs](https://github.com/gen740/Tsugumi/blob/main/protocol/tsugumi.fbs).

- **Format**: one message is one FlatBuffer (root `Tsugumi.RPC.Message`, file identifier `TSG1`). The WebSocket subprotocol is `tsugumi.rpc.v1`; on a Unix socket, a 4-byte length (little endian) is followed by the body.
- **Failure**: any request may be answered with `Failure`.
- **Requests that change something**: carry an `op_id`, and a resend with the same `op_id` is applied only once. If a response is lost, check with `OperationGet`.
- **The Agent's tools**: made from the same schema (`tsugumi.bfbs`) ([Features](features.md#9-agent)).

There are 41 requests.

## Connection

| Request | Response | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`SessionHello`](#sessionhello) | HelloResult | token is required on WebSocket. Project mismatch is permission_denied. Must be the first request, within 5 s of connecting. `protocol` is the newest version the client speaks and `min_protocol` the oldest (default: protocol); the server answers with the newest version both speak (HelloResult.protocol), or protocol_mismatch. |

### SessionHello

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `protocol` | `uint32` |  |  |
| `client_id` | `string` | yes |  |
| `expected_project_id` | `string` |  |  |
| `token` | `string` |  |  |
| `min_protocol` | `uint32` |  |  |

## Versions

| Request | Response | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`VersionInit`](#versioninit) | VersionResult | Makes the project a git repository: a first commit of what is saved (a demo's history file becomes its versions). Nothing happens when it already is one. |
| [`VersionMark`](#versionmark) | VersionResult | Names the current version: what is saved is committed (when it changed) and gets an annotated tag `name` with `message`. |
| [`VersionCheckout`](#versioncheckout) | SaveResult | Starts from a version: what is saved now is committed, then the project's files become those of `commit` and the document is read again (like ProjectReload). Only while no run is active. |
| [`VersionGraph`](#versiongraph) | VersionGraph, newest first |  |
| [`VersionCanvas`](#versioncanvas) | VersionCanvas: the Cards of a version and how they connect (a minimap) |  |
| [`VersionDiff`](#versiondiff) | VersionDiff: what a version changed from its first parent, in the text a summary is written from | Only code and settings: never data files. |
| [`VersionSummary`](#versionsummary) | VersionResult | Keeps a client's summary of a version in the commit's own note (refs/notes/tsugumi-summary), replacing the one there. |

### VersionInit
